title: Sellora – Smart POS & Real-Time Inventory Management System
short_description: Sellora is a SaaS-based POS and Inventory Management System designed to help businesses manage their daily operations more efficiently from a single platform.
description:
Sellora is a SaaS-based POS and Inventory Management System designed to help businesses manage their daily operations more efficiently from a single platform. The system provides essential tools for managing sales, purchases, products, inventory, customers, suppliers, expenses, and other business operations.

I developed Sellora together with my friend Jakir, working closely on the system architecture, backend development, database design, business logic, APIs, and core POS and inventory workflows. We focused on building the platform with scalability, maintainability, and real-world business requirements in mind.

The system is designed as a multi-business SaaS platform, allowing multiple businesses to manage their operations independently while using the same platform. We worked on developing features that simplify day-to-day business management, reduce manual work, and provide better visibility into sales and inventory.

This project gave us hands-on experience in designing and developing a complete SaaS product from the ground up, covering everything from system architecture and database structure to business logic, API development, and practical POS and inventory management workflows.

title: School/Educational institute website using Laravel
short_description: Dynamic School Web Portal (Laravel)  A modern, fast, and fully responsive informational website developed using the Laravel framework.
description:
Dynamic School Web Portal (Laravel)

A modern, fast, and fully responsive informational website developed using the Laravel framework. Designed specifically as an institutional public portal rather than a heavy ERP, it serves as a central hub for parents, students, and visitors.

Tech Stack:

* Backend: PHP, Laravel (MVC Architecture) * Frontend: Blade, Bootstrap / Tailwind CSS, JavaScript * Database: MySQL (Eloquent ORM) * Auth: Role-Based Admin Authentication

Key Features:

* Dynamic Landing Page: Hero slider, school history, mission statement, and messages from institutional leadership. * Notice Board: Chronological notices, exam routines, and circulars with direct PDF/image downloads. * Faculty Directory: Department-wise teacher profiles showcasing designations, qualifications, and photos. * Academics & Admissions: Dedicated sections for syllabus downloads, curriculums, and admission guidelines. * Media Gallery: Categorized photo albums covering campus life, sports, and cultural events. * Inquiry & Contact: Interactive contact form with server-side validation and embedded Google Maps.

Admin Panel (CMS):

* Secure dashboard to create, update, and remove notices or events. * Media and document manager for instant file uploads. * Built-in inbox to review and track incoming visitor inquiries.

Technical Highlights:

* Secure architecture leveraging Eloquent ORM, CSRF protection, and XSS sanitization. * Clean MVC pattern with modular Blade components for simple maintenance. * Fully mobile-first responsive design optimized for fast loading and local SEO.
